name: draggable-card
title: Draggable Card
description: A set of tilted photo cards strewn across a dark stage; each tilts in 3D under the pointer, lifts on hover, and can be dragged around with momentum before settling.
use: A hero or gallery wants a tactile, messy photo spread people can rearrange themselves.
avoid: Cards sit absolutely and overlap, so on small screens they collide and several labels are clipped.
a11y: Cards can only be dragged with a pointer, with no keyboard movement and no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: no, labels: none, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Six dark cards with square landscape photos and a country name below sit at different angles across a black stage, showing mountains, coast, snow and forest. Their corners overlap and shadows separate them.
behaves: Moving over a card tilts it toward the pointer and adds a faint white glare; dragging throws it in the direction of motion until a spring brings it to a stop and flattens the tilt.
customise: Wrap any children in a draggable body and position it with className; drag constraints, tilt range, spring and glare are fixed in the source.
weight: light: Six cards with springs and drag handlers; nothing animates while idle.
